_comment: Deployment Rules for DeployPipeline — configure in Fabric UI: Pipeline → ⚙️ Deployment Rules on the target stage. Rules can't be imported from a file; this is the reference for what to enter.
_how_item_references_are_handled: PL_Refresh_Master references its notebooks and dataflow by LITERAL item GUID (this is how Fabric exports/stores pipelines and what imports cleanly — expression-based notebookId/workspaceId causes the importer to hang). You do NOT rewrite those GUIDs with deployment rules. Instead, promote ALL items in the SAME deploy so the Fabric Deployment Pipeline AUTO-PAIRS them; on every Dev → Prod deploy it rewrites the pipeline's item references to the paired Prod items automatically. The only rule you still configure by hand is the semantic-model data source binding below.

rules.description: Binds the semantic model to the stage-appropriate Gold_LH SQL endpoint

_howto: 1. Open DeployPipeline in the Fabric portal
2. Build ALL items in Dev first, then assign workspaces, then Deploy once so every item auto-pairs (notebooks, dataflow, pipeline, semantic model, report)
3. Click the Deployment Rules gear on the target (Production) stage
4. Add the Gold_SM Data source rule pointing at ws-CICD-Prod/Gold_LH
5. Rules are stored on the pipeline and applied automatically on every deploy (including GitHub Actions deploys); pipeline item references are re-paired automatically and need no rule
